originalReplays.scope: Exact four original MULTI-SUB files, transcode UI sessions only; zero provider I/O
limitations: Successful start or current playback is not a permanent recovery nor a demonstrated causal fix.
Only exact-session tagged lines are counted. Multiline continuations and diagnostics without session tags are not attributed, so zero is not full decoder certification.
Gateway log windows begin at their listed container starts and do not cover earlier deployments.

errorTimeline.method: Only exact-session tagged lines, subdivided by telemetry first_frame and Gateway expiry minus15s. Final15s is a temporal bucket, not attribution to shutdown.

conclusions: Fresh category metadata agrees with exact owned stream IDs, titles and MKV containers; direct_source and custom_sid are empty. No alternate authoritative media URL was provided in those category entries.

At the recorded A/B times, HIT still refused both modes without media; the other three original files delivered matching 64 KiB Matroska prefixes through both modes. These later successes do not establish why the earlier requests failed.

The three original UI replays started with unchanged target hashes, but input EBML and video/audio diagnostics occurred before first frame and during playback. Start success is not verified fluid playback or a causal repair.
Server/container image and transport policy remained as recorded; no provider media request was issued by this audit script.
The original browser User-Agent was not retained. A production-default UA in independent diagnostics is not proof of the historical browser request header.
Only tagged diagnostics are counted. Non-tagged continuation lines and aggregate repeated counts are not expanded. Close-adjacent time buckets do not attribute cause.

retainedMetadataReview.scope: Saved get_vod_info reduced fields and full exact get_vod_streams target objects only
limitations: The get_vod_info response was deliberately reduced; absent retained duration/audio/status/node keys cannot establish absence in the original response.

The complete retained get_vod_streams objects provide no explicit availability, update, duration, audio-track or serving-node fields among the inspected names. Listing plus HTTP200 is not proof of media availability.
The provider added timestamp is entry creation metadata, not a recent health/update observation.
